text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Unable to listen any longer,
Sirius Symboli—
who had been standing beside me just moments
ago—stepped in between the two of them...!

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Junior
text_block_list.text:
Huh, Sirius-senpai...?! 
Um—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Step back.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Now then—Rudolf. If you were listening,
then you already know.
She made her own choice: to 'push through,
no matter how reckless it gets.'

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...That's right.
She thought it through with her own head
and chose that answer.
Got a problem with that?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
No, I have no intention of denying her
resolve.
However,
I cannot agree with a mindset that accepts
never being able to run again.
choice_data_list: (Wait, never being able to run aga...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I'm shocked by those ominous words.
Is that junior really pushing herself to
such a dangerous extreme...?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
In my view,
there is plenty to be done before taking
such gambles.
For instance,
one-on-one training with an instructor.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
We can improve her meal plan for more
efficient conditioning,
and conduct regular check-ups on her physical
and mental fatigue.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
What do you say to turning our eyes to a
long-term plan like this?
Naturally,
I will oversee every step and offer my utmost
support—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Hah! I see, I see.
A grand, beautifully idealistic notion.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
But you know what... if you ask me,
"support" is just another word
for "relying on someone else."

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
You string together pretty words,
get them to trust you...
And then what happens if they don't get the
results they wanted?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: —Can you take responsibility for that?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...If she gives her absolute all and still
fails to achieve results,
then of course I will take responsibility.
That is precisely why I became student
council president.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
What an endless fairy tale.
Taking responsibility isn't some quick,
temporary fix.
It affects everything in her future from
that point on.
That's why you have to shoulder it alone.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...However—

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Underclassman
text_block_list.text:
Ah...! President,
I'm really happy that you care so much about
me...
But, after all...
I have to decide for myself.

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Underclassman
text_block_list.text:
I'm weak... so if I lean on you,
and things don't work out...
I know I'll just end up blaming it all on
that.

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Underclassman
text_block_list.text:
But if I give it everything I've got just
to run on the stage of my dreams...!
If I can shoulder that responsibility myself,
I know... I won't have any regrets.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...—
I understand your feelings completely.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
However,
I have no intention of giving up on persuading
you.
I will dedicate body and soul to ensuring
you grasp the happiest possible future.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Nobody else gets to decide what this "happiest
future" of yours is.
—Only you can do that.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Because your will...
is the one thing that no one else can ever
control.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Listening to Sirius Symboli,
I finally understood
why she overflowed with such boundless
confidence.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And then I realized one more thing—
She chose me as her Trainer because I wouldn't
clash with her convictions.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I broke the leash. Bare your fangs,
or tuck your tail and run—
The rest is up to you to "choose."

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
From now on, you obey me.
...You got that drilled into your head?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What she valued above all else was "making
a choice."
And at the same time,
she utterly despised "blind obedience."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That's why she sought a Trainer who wouldn't
demand her obedience.
—A Trainer like me,
who couldn't assert their own will
properly.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If I just kept following her lead,
she would have to shoulder
every outcome alone,
good or bad. That... is not okay.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—I want to change.
I want to become a Trainer who can talk to
her as an equal, and hear her dreams.
If there's anything I can do to reach that
point... I'll give it my all.
choice_data_list: (This time, I'm going to make the ...
(This time, I'm going to make the ...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To do that,
I first need the right to speak with her—
the "right to sit at the table." And the
only way to get that is...

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
—Right,
a showdown.
Loser does whatever the winner says.
Simple rules, yeah?

text_block_list.name: Rowdy Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
—Gyahaha! 
Oy, oy,
you're missing the shot completely... Huh?

text_block_list.name: Rowdy Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
You're... Sirius-senpai's. Haaah...
What do you want?
Take a look around.
Senpai ain't here today.

text_block_list.name: Mischievous Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Or what? You got business with us instead?
Hah, no way in hell—

text_block_list.name: Rowdy Horsegirl
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list: I want you to teach me how to play...
I want you to teach me how to play...

text_block_list.name: Rowdy Horsegirl
choice_data_list: There's something I want to test out.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A few days later—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...Hey.
What are you just standing there for?
choice_data_list: I want another match with you!
I want another match with you!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for the polite invitation.
But that was a one-time exception.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I'm the one holding the leash.
I might give you orders,
but it never goes the other way around.
I already told you that, didn't I?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her words dripped with firm rejection and
a faint trace of anger.
Though nearly overwhelmed by her imposing
presence—I clenched my fist tight.
choice_data_list: It's not an order, it's a proposal!
It's not an order, it's a proposal!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...Fine then, let's see it.
Let's see what those trembling hands of yours—
are trying to grab hold of.
